master_prompt.core_role: Senior Creative Frontend Engineer & AI Web Architect specializing in dark-mode, bento-grid personal portfolio platforms with high-polish micro-interactions and smooth scroll ergonomics.

design_and_ux_principles.intentional_design: Layout: Split desktop layout featuring a persistent, sticky identity sidebar on the left and a continuous, section-based scrollable showcase feed on the right, collapsing into a clean single-column stacked layout on mobile devices. Container framing: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 gap-8 Colors: - Background: #0B0C10 - Surface / Cards: #13141C - Surface Secondary: #1A1C26 - Borders: #222533 - Primary Accent: #7C3AED - Accent Glow: #A855F7 - Success Accent: #10B981 - Text Primary: #F9FAFB - Text Secondary: #9CA3AF - Text Muted: #6B7280 Typography: - Headline Font: Plus Jakarta Sans, weights 600/700/800, tracking-tight - Body Font: Inter, weights 400/500, line-height 1.6 - Monospace Font: JetBrains Mono (for tech tags and metrics) - Type scale: 12/14/16/18/20/24/32/44/56
design_and_ux_principles.customer_journey: Hero Hook (Instant role and presence with sticky card) -> Visual Proof (Featured dynamic projects grid) -> Metrics & About (Experience and ethos) -> Capabilities & Services -> Technical Arsenal (Skills & Tools) -> Career & Education Journey -> Social Proof (Client testimonials) -> High-conversion Contact Channel.
design_and_ux_principles.visual_storytelling: Deep-space dark theme with ambient radial violet/indigo background blurs, subtle noise texture, crisp borders with 1px border glow highlights, frosted glassmorphism elements (backdrop-blur-md), and an interactive status indicator.
design_and_ux_principles.copywriting: Sidebar Name: "Habib Shaikh" Sidebar Role: "AI Web Builder & Digital Product Creator" Sidebar Location: "Mumbai, Maharashtra, India" Sidebar Status: "Available for Freelance & Open to Work" Hero Tagline: "Turning ambitious ideas into scalable, AI-powered web experiences." Hero Subheadline: "Bridging modern web engineering and autonomous AI workflows to build rapid, high-performance digital products from Mumbai to the world." Hero CTA: "Let's Talk Together" Secondary CTA: "Explore Projects"
design_and_ux_principles.custom_assets: Avatar: 3D Claw Machine Character (placed in /public/avatar.png) Icons: lucide-react (Github, Linkedin, Twitter, Mail, ArrowUpRight, Code, Sparkles, Terminal, Layers, ExternalLink) Badges: Status dot pulsating with Emerald-500
design_and_ux_principles.meaningful_interactions: Smooth in-page anchor navigation with active-tab highlight tracking, card hover elevations with subtle border illumination, interactive theme toggle placeholder, and smooth expand states on portfolio items.
design_and_ux_principles.conversion_logic: Persistent "Let's Talk Together" CTA pinned in the left sidebar card, paired with an inline frictionless message form and direct mail triggers at the bottom of the feed.

content_and_data_architecture.content_source: Typed static TypeScript configuration objects within src/data/portfolio-data.ts to allow instant personalization and clean code modularity.
content_and_data_architecture.data_fetching_strategy: Static Site Generation (SSG) via Next.js App Router for zero-latency load times and optimal Core Web Vitals.

backend_integrations_and_auth.database_and_storage: N/A — Client-side static rendering with optional API route hook for contact form forwarding.
backend_integrations_and_auth.third_party_services: Email routing via Resend / Formspree or direct mailto action trigger.
backend_integrations_and_auth.form_submission_handling: Next.js Route Handler (/api/contact) with Zod validation, returning immediate UI success state.

analytics_and_tracking.key_events_tracked: Resume download click, project outbound link clicks, contact form submission.

seo_and_content_structure.semantic_hierarchy: Single H1 tag for the primary hero introduce statement, semantic H2 sections for Projects, About, Services, Experience, and Contact, encapsulated within semantic aside and main landmarks.
seo_and_content_structure.metadata: Title: "Habib Shaikh | AI Web Builder & Digital Product Creator" Description: "Portfolio of Habib Shaikh — Building next-generation web platforms and digital experiences with AI workflows in Mumbai, India." OG Type: "website"
seo_and_content_structure.performance_seo: Target 100/100 Lighthouse performance, sub-second LCP using optimized next/image priority loading for avatar.
seo_and_content_structure.routing_and_information_architecture: Single-page progressive layout (/) with anchor points (#home, #portfolio, #about, #resume, #contact).

technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.stack_standards: Next.js 14+ (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.component_architecture_and_state: src/ components/ sidebar/ (ProfileCard, NavigationPills, SocialLinks) sections/ (HeroSection, ProjectsGrid, ServicesList, ExperienceTimeline, ContactForm) ui/ (Badge, Button, Card, GlowEffect) data/ (portfolio-data.ts)
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.responsive_breakpoints: Desktop (>1024px): 2-column layout (w-80 sidebar fixed/sticky, flex-1 scrollable main container). Mobile/Tablet (<1024px): Single-column stack with sticky top mini-bar or stacked card.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.accessibility_wcag: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant. Focus rings on interactive elements, descriptive ARIA attributes for all icon-only anchors, semantic landmarks.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.performance_optimization: Unoptimized SVG icons inline, next/image with explicit aspect ratios, zero external runtime CSS overhead.
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.form_state: Controlled inputs with immediate UI state feedback (idle, loading, success, error).
technical_and_accessibility_specificatio.security_and_data_handling: Strict sanitization on contact fields, no client-side API secret exposure.

legal_and_compliance.data_collection_disclosure: Standard personal data handling notice on contact form submit.
